shellCommands.command: find pages components styles __agent_eval__ -type f | sort && echo "---" && cat next.config.ts tsconfig.json
for f in pages/index.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js components/AppProvider.js; do echo "=========== $f"; cat -n "$f"; done
for f in pages/blog/index.js pages/blog/\[id\].js pages/api/posts/index.js pages/api/posts/\[id\].js styles/globals.css __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=========== $f"; cat -n "$f"; done

ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/ && echo "--- file-conventions" && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/*file-conventions* && echo "--- functions" && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/*functions* && echo "--- upgrading" && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions && wc -l page.md layout.md route.md error.md not-found.md && echo "==== PAGE ====" && cat page.md

sed -n '1,90p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/13-fonts.md; echo "=== metadata head links ==="; grep -n -B3 -A20 "rel=\"icon\"\|preconnect\|External Stylesheets" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/11-css.md | head -60
grep -n -A40 "## Root Layout\|### Root Layout\|Layout Props Helper" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/layout.md | head -120

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -rn "not-found" --include=*.md 01-app/01-getting-started/14-metadata-and-og-images.md 01-app/01-getting-started/10-error-handling.md 01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-metadata.md | head -20; echo "=== React title/meta support ==="; grep -rn "React \[\`<title>\`\]\|react-dom/components/title\|hoist" --include=*.md 01-app | head -20

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist && grep -rn "notFound.*metadata\|metadata.*notFound" --include=*.js server/lib/ build/ lib/metadata/ 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== resolve-metadata mod types ==="; grep -rn "'not-found'\|\"not-found\"" lib/metadata/resolve-metadata.js build/utils.js 2>/dev/null | head
grep -rln "notFoundErrorConvention" . | head && echo "---" && grep -rn -B5 -A25 "notFoundErrorConvention" lib/metadata/resolve-metadata.js 2>/dev/null | head -60
cd /workspace && rm -rf pages components/AppProvider.js && find app components types styles -type f | sort && echo "--- pages exists?" && ls pages 2>&1
cd /workspace && npx next typegen 2>&1 | tail -20 && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -30

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 8; 
echo "--- / (title, UA, timestamp, nav)"; curl -s -A "SmokeTest/1.0" localhost:3111 | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|Your user agent: [^<]*\|og:title[^>]*\|Server-side rendered at: [^<]*' | head
echo "--- /blog"; curl -s localhost:3111/blog | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' 
echo "--- /blog/1"; curl -s localhost:3111/blog/1 | grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>\|og:description[^>]*' | head -3
echo "--- /blog/99999 (notFound)"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" localhost:3111/blog/99999; curl -s localhost:3111/blog/99999 | grep -o '404 - Page Not Found' | head -1
echo "--- /nope"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "status=%{http_code}\n" localhost:3111/nope
echo "--- font self-hosted?"; curl -s localhost:3111 | grep -o 'fonts.googleapis.com\|/_next/static/media/[^"]*\.woff2' | head -3

cd /workspace
echo "--- GET /api/posts"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" localhost:3111/api/posts
echo "--- POST valid"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -X POST localhost:3111/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"T","content":"C"}'
echo "--- POST invalid"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -X POST localhost:3111/api/posts -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"T"}'
echo "--- POST no body"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -X POST localhost:3111/api/posts
echo "--- DELETE on collection (405?)"; curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X DELETE localhost:3111/api/posts | grep -i "^HTTP\|^allow"
echo "--- GET /api/posts/7"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" localhost:3111/api/posts/7
echo "--- PUT /api/posts/7"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -X PUT localhost:3111/api/posts/7 -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title":"New"}'
echo "--- PUT no body"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -X PUT localhost:3111/api/posts/7
echo "--- DELETE /api/posts/7"; curl -s -w " [%{http_code}]\n" -X DELETE localhost:3111/api/posts/7
echo "--- POST on /api/posts/7 (405?)"; curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X POST localhost:3111/api/posts/7 | grep -i "^HTTP\|^allow"
echo "--- noindex on notFound page?"; curl -s localhost:3111/blog/99999 | grep -o 'name="robots" content="[^"]*"' | head -2
pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short && echo "--- tsconfig diff" && git diff tsconfig.json package.json && cat .gitignore
git status --short; echo "--- tsconfig/package diff"; git diff tsconfig.json package.json; echo "--- gitignore"; cat .gitignore

rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25 && echo "=== TSC ===" && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "tsc clean" && echo "=== STATUS ===" && git status --short && git diff --stat tsconfig.json
